verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs say its accounts, payments and cards come with transaction data, including "settlement-level transaction visibility" across ACH, wires, RTP and checks, so transaction data is a first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence describes what that data contains or how rich it is. missing for 10: documented counterparty fields, rail-specific metadata (e.g. ACH/wire/RTP details), stable transaction identifiers, merchant/category enrichment, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of data richness.

support.subject: As a developer, transaction data is rich enough to build on — counterparty details, rail-specific metadata, stable identifiers, and enrichment that makes a raw bank feed usable in-product

citations.quote: Send and receive money using payment capabilities including ACH, wires, real-time payments, checks, and international payments, with settlement-level transaction visibility.
with real-time balances and transaction data
real-time authorization capabilities, transaction data, and card lifecycle management
The Unit Dashboard and APIs provide teams with access to customer, account, payment, card, transaction, compliance, and operational data.
